description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams' used to encapsulate search filter parameters for employee leave entitlement usage reports within the OrangeHRM leave module. It extends a base date range filter class, manages filtering by employee number and report type, and ensures the report type is valid.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for filtering employee leave entitlement usage report searches, including employee number and report type, with validation for report type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'leaveType.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter, which can be null.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getReportType
methods.description: Retrieves the current report type filter.

methods.name: setReportType
methods.description: Validates and sets the report type filter; throws InvalidArgumentException if invalid.
